params.body:
Shane: "edit screen on mobile has no saving button".

## What was wrong

Reproduced at 390x844 (Playwright, seeded dealer, one photo). The editor is Toast UI in an iframe inside `#editImageModal`. The script hung the Save button in Toast UI's header, and that header has `min-width: 533px` inside a container with `overflow: hidden`: in a 351px iframe the button sat at x=405, unreachable, no scroll. The menu bar (409px) was clipped on both sides for the same reason, the submenu (`app.scss` pins it to a 400px box at the right, for the desktop) hung 49px off the left edge, and the canvas was resized a second later in `vw` with no height limit: at 1440 the photo ran 60px under the menu bar.

## What changed

Same shape as PR 340/387: no box in a box, what must stay put stays put.

- The editor page is one column: the editor takes the height that is left, and on a phone a bar under it carries Save (44px tall, always in view, above the home indicator). On a desktop Save stays where it was, top right in Toast UI's header; the script places the same button depending on `(max-width: 767px)` and moves it on rotation.
- The modal itself is full screen on a phone (no margins, the iframe takes what the header leaves).
- Menu bar at the bottom: scrolls sideways, every item at least 44x44. Submenu spans the width and scrolls sideways when it does not fit.
- Canvas: `cssMaxWidth`/`cssMaxHeight` are computed from the box the editor really has (viewport minus the bars; on a phone also minus the submenu, so it never covers the photo) and refitted on resize with `resizeCanvasDimension`. The fixed 1300x1000 and the `setTimeout` vw hack are gone. On a desktop the photo no longer runs under the menu bar (800x600 in a 1296x744 iframe instead of 907x680).
- `_edit_image_modal.scss` loses its `#tui-image-editor { height: 100vh !important }`; the column in `refresh.css` (`ui-image-editor`, `ui-image-editor-bar`) owns the height now.

Saving verified end to end at 390: drew a rectangle, tapped Save, the PUT returned the photo id, the file on the same path was overwritten (plus thumbnail and derived sizes), `media_version`/`media_set` set, the modal closed and the tile showed the new photo.

## Pinned

`ImageEditorSaveTest` (4 tests): the page structure the CSS relies on (editor and Save bar in one column, no fixed `cssMaxWidth: 1300`, refit on resize), and the request: same path overwritten, thumbnail written, `media_version` bumped, 422 with a message on an empty stream, 403 for another dealer's photo. Rule S1-6.12 said this action does not check ownership; the code does, the rule is corrected. New rule S1-6.30 (screen). Finding file `2026-09-15-foto-editor-geen-opslaan-op-telefoon.md` (opgelost).

## Also checked

`asset('node_modules/...')`: `public/node_modules` is gitignored and filled by `vite-plugin-static-copy` on `npm run build` (vite.config.js lines 38-41: tui-image-editor, fabric, tui-code-snippet, tui-color-picker). Forge runs the build on deploy, so the four files load (all 200 in the network log). Not a finding.

Left as is: on a desktop the 400px submenu box (app.scss) still overlaps the lower right corner of the photo while a submenu is open. Pre-existing and cosmetic; a full-width submenu would need the canvas height to shrink by 150px on a desktop too.

Tests: `HandlerWiring|AlpineExpression|StylesheetSyntax|CompiledViews|Image|Photo|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity`: OK (100 tests, 1023 assertions).
params.title: The photo editor can save on a phone
